verdict.rationale: Svelte is an open-source UI framework and compiler that runs in the developer's own toolchain and does not hold user data, so a training-data opt-out is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Svelte ships a data-collecting service with training-use terms, so the axis does not apply. The MCP server described in svelte-docs-19 only supplies documentation and static analysis, with no mention of data retention or training use.
